artifacts.claim: Subscription-scope modular Bicep, sanitized what-if, expected-resource reconciliation, and a live Trial-only deployment.
artifacts.service: Azure Resource Manager and Azure Databricks
artifacts.notes: Trial workspace, isolated resource group, modular Bicep deployment, and reconciled live inventory are represented together.

artifacts.claim: Managed identities, Access Connector, resource-group-scoped RBAC, Key Vault isolation, and a successful GitHub OIDC validation.
artifacts.service: Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Key Vault
artifacts.notes: Managed identities handled data access and GitHub OIDC completed a resource-group-scoped deployment validation without a cloud password.

artifacts.claim: Hierarchical namespace, TLS 1.2, disabled shared keys, and executed landing, checkpoint, quarantine, and evidence paths.
artifacts.notes: Six deterministic files were uploaded through Azure AD RBAC without storage keys; governed landing and checkpoint paths were exercised.

artifacts.claim: A parameterized ForEach and six successful managed-identity Copy activities landed 30,000 commit-pinned rows.
artifacts.notes: The successful ForEach run reconciles six Copy activities and 30,000 rows from immutable public source URLs.

artifacts.claim: Exactly 20,000 bounded messages reconciled through the Kafka-compatible interface, checkpoint, and Bronze Delta table.
artifacts.service: Azure Event Hubs and Structured Streaming
artifacts.notes: Producer, Azure Monitor, final partition offsets, zero lag, checkpoint state, and Bronze Delta count reconcile to 20,000 messages.

artifacts.claim: The live catalog applies managed storage, external locations, ownership, grants, comments, tags, and a column mask.
artifacts.notes: Managed storage, external locations, ownership, grants, comments, tags, and a column mask were applied in the live catalog.

artifacts.claim: Executed Bronze tables preserve source file and system, ingest and event time, run ID, record hash, and schema version.
artifacts.notes: The executed Bronze tables retain source identity, ingestion and event timestamps, pipeline run, record hash, and schema version.

artifacts.claim: Lakeflow published expectation metrics, routed invalid records, and enforced a real fail-on-violation contract.
artifacts.notes: Warning metrics, quarantine routing, and the reserved fail-on-violation contract were all exercised on the live pipeline.

artifacts.claim: Executed conformance enforced schemas, types, units, keys, joins, deduplication, domains, and idempotent outputs.
artifacts.notes: Silver outputs reconcile deterministic validation, conformance, deduplication, unit normalization, and quarantine counts.

artifacts.claim: Lakeflow AUTO CDC produced 647 effective-dated rows and passed the one-current-version invariant; the MERGE fallback was not used.
artifacts.notes: The live CHANGE flow produced 647 effective-dated versions with zero current-version invariant violations; the fallback was not used.

artifacts.claim: Two facts, three dimensions, and one KPI output were published with documented grain, keys, lineage, and validation SQL.
artifacts.notes: Two facts, three dimensions, and one KPI table were published at documented grains and passed count, key, and aggregate validation.

artifacts.claim: The complete ten-task dependency graph succeeded on bounded ephemeral Trial compute.
artifacts.notes: The ten-task DAG completed successfully with parallel Bronze paths and dependency-gated quality, Silver, history, Gold, validation, and receipt tasks.

artifacts.claim: Unity Catalog recorded live table and column lineage from conformed quality data into Gold outputs.
artifacts.notes: Live table and column lineage connects the conformed Silver quality data to the Gold fact and derived quality flag.

artifacts.claim: A reserved hard failure stopped the real quality gate; focused repair preserved successful upstream work and reproduced clean hashes.
artifacts.notes: A real expectation failure was diagnosed and repaired on the same run; completed upstream work remained intact and recovered content matched the clean baseline.

artifacts.claim: Six five-million-row runs showed the broadcast plan was 39.009% slower by median wall time; result hashes matched and unavailable Spark Connect status-store metrics are explicit.
artifacts.notes: Three baseline and three broadcast runs used the same five-million-row fixture and compute; all result hashes matched.
artifacts.limitation: The broadcast median was 39.009% slower, and Spark Connect did not expose classic status-store task, stage, shuffle, spill, partition, maximum-task, or p75 metrics.

artifacts.claim: Diagnostics and the alert rule were configured; the data-plane incident did not fire the control-plane alert, Log Analytics had no visible rows in-window, and cost remained pending settlement.
artifacts.service: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Cost Management
artifacts.notes: Diagnostics preceded workloads and the alert rule was enabled; cost snapshots retained the exact pending-settlement label.
artifacts.limitation: No Log Analytics rows were visible in the bounded window, the data-plane quality incident did not fire the administrative alert, and Cost Management returned no settled amount.

artifacts.claim: Local, security, IaC, bundle, publication, Pages, and a resource-group-scoped OIDC deployment validation protect release quality.
artifacts.notes: A green CI run and a separate successful OIDC-backed Azure deployment validation are linked by public workflow receipts.

artifacts.claim: Azure confirmed the isolated resource group, Databricks-managed resource group, and Part 4 budget absent after exact-scope deletion and 20 authoritative polls.
artifacts.service: Azure Resource Manager and Cost Management
artifacts.notes: Azure confirmed both isolated resource groups and the Part 4 budget absent after 20 polls; the shared metastore and unrelated resources were preserved.

artifacts.claim: Every major claim binds platform capture, code, receipt, validation, UTC time, commit, and SHA-256.
artifacts.notes: A single validated content model and generated manifest drive the README, site, evidence explorer, and 32-page document.
artifacts.limitation: Generated explanatory panels are labeled as generated artifacts and are not represented as platform screenshots.
